label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark leads U.S. Open
items.text: Wyndham Clark finished the U.S. Open at 7-under par, leading by four strokes over Matt Fitzpatrick, Xander Schauffele, Sam Stevens, and Tom Kim, who all finished at 3-under.

items.headline: DeChambeau misses U.S. Open cut
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau made two double bogeys early Friday due to three-putts and ultimately missed the cut at the U.S. Open.

items.headline: Scottie Scheffler skips Travelers
items.text: World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler is committed to play next week’s Travelers Championship, but Rory McIlroy is skipping it, making him the only top-50 player not in the field.
